title: Two crafts. One studio.
intro: GDUXI is a merger between not just two minds but also two professionals delivering their own skills at perfection as ONE.
story_quote: GD + UX/uI: graphic design and UX/UI as one practice. We design the mark and the experience together, so the join never shows.
story_body: Our name is our two crafts: GD for graphic design, UXI for UX/UI. The colours flow from cobalt into violet and orchid, and the wave lines come from our own banner work.

values.title: Research before pixels
values.body: We talk to your customers before we design for them. Decisions come with reasons.

values.title: Craft you can feel
values.body: Hand-drawn marks and calm interfaces, never template-generic. Built to stand out from AI sameness.

values.title: No surprises
values.body: Clear milestones, a fixed quote upfront and regular check-ins. You always know what's next.
